title: Certified Production Recovery live-authority candidate gate

phases.objective: Allow an explicit Hostinger Production server-managed binding request to be validated as a non-live activation candidate, evaluate the candidate against existing signed certification and deployment-attestation authorities, and keep all route mutation authority fail-closed.

e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: A complete deployment-owned Production candidate graph can be inspected for activation eligibility while the returned runtime composition remains fail_closed with mutation_authority_available=false and live_activation=false.
steps: Resolve runtime identity and accept Production intent only for explicit production_hostinger_autodeploy.
Load the deployment-owned server-managed binding resolver without accepting caller, GPT, Local Connector, raw SQL, or secret-bearing envelope fields.
Validate the complete adapter graph using the canonical Recovery composition contract.
Convert Production intent into candidate metadata only; discard the candidate adapters from route dependencies by returning the canonical fail-closed composition.

Evaluate candidate component status against signed staging certification, exact Production deployment attestation, target fingerprint, artifact parity, typed adapter provenance, and unresolved-incident gates.
Assert live activation and Production/database/provider mutation remain false.
assertions: generic or ambiguous Production runtime cannot request a candidate
only explicit hostinger_autodeploy can carry production_live intent
candidate adapters are validated but never exposed as route mutation authority

phases.objective: Deploy the independently certified server-managed binding module and signed readiness evidence, then collect a fresh Production activation-readiness result without enabling mutation.
Keep Production live execution disabled until exact deployment evidence proves activation_eligible and a separate explicit Production activation authorization is granted.
